messages:
maria_support: FYI escalated from Katie at St. Lucas — their compliance team says the BAA audit export for March week (2025-03-01 -> 2025-03-07) is missing user action entries (e.g. data-access events). They flagged it as a potential retention/audit gap.

katie_cs: customer reports missing ~1200 'access' events in the export compared to what's in the console. They attached a CSV summary. They need an explanation and an export fix within 24h.

maria_support: I pulled the export job id they referenced: export-20250308-84f2. Logs show `EXPORT_COMPLETE` but with warnings around KMS decrypt for some objects. Snippet:```
WARN export: object s3://redwood-exports/st-lucas/export-20250308/part-0005.json.gz: KMSDecryptError: wrong key version: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/abcd-rotated
```

aj_prodsec: can we confirm whether KMS key rotation coincided with the export window? If rotated, old objects may need re-decrypt with previous key version (we keep key versions).

sam_engineering: checking internal logs — looks like there was an automated key rotation on 2025-03-05 22:03:12 UTC for st-lucas KMS alias. Some older archive objects still reference the prior key version id. Export job should have used the latest key mapping, but the S3 copy process stores the envelope key id.

jess_oncall: mysql-purple-archiver/pipeline shows a retry loop for part-0005, retried 3x then proceeded. Error was KMS decrypt failure but job didn't fail the whole export. That would explain missing entries: part-0005 contains ~7% of rows.

maria_support: customer expects exact audit trail for HIPAA/BAA. This is a compliance issue — we need to reconstruct the missing rows and provide a corrected export, plus root cause + mitigation.

aj_prodsec: action items: (1) attempt manual decrypt of part-0005 with previous key version, (2) if successful, rebuild export and resend, (3) add a post-rotation validation to export pipeline to fail-fast on decrypt mismatches, (4) notify customer and draft timeline. I'll take (1) and (3).

sam_engineering: running manual decrypt now. Command I used:```
redwood-s3 decrypt --bucket redwood-exports --key-prefix st-lucas/export-20250308/part-0005.json.gz --kms-key-id 1234-previous-key-version --out /tmp/part-0005.json.gz
```

sam_engineering: decrypt succeeded locally, file integrity looks OK, contains ~43k events. Re-run of export-assemble step to include part-0005 in final CSV is in progress. ETA ~30m.

katie_cs: thanks — customer wants confirmation we'll deliver the corrected export and a short RCA. They're also asking whether this could affect other customers (they're concerned about systemic BAA risk).

aj_prodsec: it's scoped to customers who had active KMS rotations during running export jobs in that time window. We'll scan recent exports for KMSDecryptWarning counts > 0. I'll produce a one-page RCA and a mitigation plan.

jess_oncall: I'm patching the export pipeline to check `KMSDecryptWarning` metrics and fail the export with a clear audit error when any decrypt warnings occur. Will open a PR and request expedited review.

maria_support: can someone confirm if we retained previous key versions for st-lucas (they're asking for attestations)? Also need to confirm retention policy for audit logs and the timeline for a corrected export.

aj_prodsec: we retain prior KMS key versions for 90 days by policy for rotation events. I'll attach the attestation language in the response. For timeline: corrected export + RCA within 12 hours, interim update in 3 hours.

sam_engineering: corrected export assembled and uploaded to temp location: s3://redwood-esc-priv/st-lucas/corrected/export-20250308-fixed.csv.gz (pre-signed link created). Verified counts match console.

deploy_bot: build/exp-assemble/4321 succeeded in 10m 03s — artifact uploaded.

maria_support: I'll send the corrected export to the customer and include the counts, top-level checksums, and the RCA draft. Katie please review before I send. @katie_cs

katie_cs: reviewing now. A couple of wording tweaks then send. Also asking legal to confirm the BAA notification wording.

aj_prodsec: RCA draft summary (short): root cause = KMS key rotation occurred during export run; export pipeline retried but didn't fail when individual object decrypts failed, resulting in partial omission. Remediation = use key-version-aware decrypt flow, add fail-fast on decrypt warnings, and add export end-to-end checksum validation. Long-term = automation to re-encrypt legacy objects at rotation time or to snapshot key metadata prior to rotation.

maria_support: thanks team. Owners: sam_engineering (reconstruct + verified export), aj_prodsec (RCA + mitigation + legal attestation), jess_oncall (pipeline fail-fast patch). I'll update customer in ~45m with interim note.

katie_cs: customer confirmed receipt of interim note and appreciates the quick action. They'll accept corrected export and will coordinate legal review with our attestation. :+1:

maria_support: closing loop: exported artifact delivered, RCA sent to customer and legal. jess_oncall follow-up PR merged to add decrypt warnings as a hard failure. aj_prodsec to open a follow-up ticket for cross-customer scan (priority P2).

sam_engineering: marking this thread resolved on our side. Leaving notes in the export pipeline run for audit.

maria_support: thanks everyone — good catch.
